$comment: In the field. To add a moment: put 1-4 photos in media-src/field/<slug>/, add an entry below, run `npm run media`, commit. type is "moment" or "recognition"; the Recognition sub-section only appears once an entry has type "recognition". date is YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM. outcome, link and video are optional; link.rel (e.g. "sponsored noopener") marks a paid or partner link. focus is the CSS object-position used when a photo is cropped into a card.

moments.title: Ajo Student Ambassador
moments.story: I joined Ajo as a Student Ambassador, my first brand partnership. Ajo brings the rotating savings circle into an app: a group contributes on a set schedule, and each member receives the full pot in turn. I'm introducing it to students at the University of Windsor. This is a compensated ambassador role.

photos.alt: Edima in a red and cream jacket giving a thumbs up beside a man in a white Ajo T-shirt, inside a university building

moments.title: VentureU 2026
moments.story: Over Reading Week, 100 University of Windsor students were put into teams and handed real Windsor-Essex problems. Ours was agricultural waste: an estimated 27,215 tons of tomato vines go from Leamington's greenhouses to landfill every year.
moments.outcome: Our team, I.N.Q (Innovation Never Quits), won the final pitch for our problem statement and a $5,000 team prize.

photos.alt: Edima on stage with six others holding gold trophies, in front of a screen reading VentureU Final Pitch Competition, Problem Statement 2 Winner
Edima and his three teammates holding gold trophies in the Odette School of Business atrium, beside a yellow Fusion banner
Selfie of Edima with his team around a work table covered in colour-coded sticky notes during the bootcamp
A gold trophy with a plaque reading VentureU 2026 Pitch Winner

moments.title: Threads of Impact
moments.story: At our booth, we helped visitors upcycle previously loved clothing. We also showed them practical ways to reduce textile waste, drawing on my textile waste research.
moments.outcome: All proceeds from the event went to the Circularity Council of Canada.

photos.alt: Edima at the Net Impact Odette booth, stamping a design onto a tote bag beside wooden stamps, an ink roller and price signs

moments.title: RAEON field day
moments.story: I volunteered for a RAEON field day, sampling water on tributaries of Lake St. Clair. My Windsor–Essex Water Quality app maps open water quality data from 20 community science sites in the region.

photos.alt: Edima in a high-visibility vest on an overpass, looking through binoculars and pointing into the distance
A handheld water quality meter held over a muddy, tree-lined tributary
A tributary covered in lily pads, with a nesting box on a post and forest on both banks
Close-up of lily pads and two white water lilies

video.alt: Short silent clip looking out over a forest canopy and a shoreline path, panning to open water
